items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: And Berry Gordy went to Detroit and upset everybody.

ctx.x: It was unfortunate that you all couldn't get together, but a couple of guys did finally -- Clyde Otis broke through. Johnny Pate broke through in Chicago, and a couple more guys.
And Berry Gordy went to Detroit and upset everybody.
But man, this was a fabulous era, and you were doing at least 3 record dates every day.
